title: Ensuring Equitable Outcomes in Housing Redevelopment
what_it_is: Ensuring Equitable Outcomes in Housing Redevelopment

sections.label: SERS residents spoken with
sections.summary: The speaker has spoken with residents about SERS effects and has 606 affected households.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin):   Since the announcement of SERS in April, I have spoken with a number of residents about the effect of SERS on their lives.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I have a total of 606 households affected by SERS.

sections.label: SERS selective scheme scope
sections.summary: SERS is limited to precincts with high redevelopment potential, about 5% of HDB estates, with most projects selected.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: SERS is a selective scheme limited to precincts with high redevelopment potential.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: We have heard that this applies to only approximately 5% of all HDB estates and that most projects have already been selected.

sections.label: Ang Mo Kio SERS flats
sections.summary: The Ang Mo Kio SERS flats are about 43 years old with around 56 years lease left, and over half the residents are over 55.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: To illustrate this, the SERS flats in this Ang Mo Kio are approximately 43 years old, with around 56 years left on the lease as of the date of the announcement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: At the same time, more than half of my residents are over the age of 55.

sections.label: Residents' top-up cost worries
sections.summary: Residents were told of possible top-ups of $135,000, or $70,000 to $90,000, to keep a same-size flat.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Due to the difference in lease values of the old and new flat, according to him, HDB's conservative estimates were that he might have to pay $135,000 if he chooses a comparable unit of the same size.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: And many residents who showed me their estimated financial plans were worried that just to maintain a flat of the same size at the replacement site, could involve a top-up of $70,000, $80,000 or $90,000, which meant dipping into their retirement savings, or trying to find a new loan.

sections.label: CPF, SERS grant, out-of-pocket
sections.summary: Residents can use CPF refunds, get a $30,000 SERS grant, and may be $55,000 out-of-pocket for a 99-year 4-room flat.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Residents will be able to use all their CPF refunded sums to buy a new flat, they are eligible for a SERS grant of $30,000 and there is no outstanding loan for their current home.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In the same examples provided by HDB, should the current home owner pick the 99-year lease option for a replacement 4-room flat, they could be $55,000 out-of-pocket, as an estimate.

sections.label: Seniors and LBS take-up
sections.summary: Many SERS residents are seniors who may qualify for LBS, but take-up was 1,636 households in 2019 and 1,528 in 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Given that many living in these SERS blocks are seniors, a significant portion will qualify for this.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: However, the take-up rate of LBS is low, is fairly small – 1,636 households in 2019 and 1,528 households in 2020.

sections.label: Residents paying resale levy
sections.summary: About a quarter of the 606 resident households are required to pay a resale levy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Out of the 606 resident households, there are approximately a quarter of residents who are required to pay a resale levy.

sections.label: 4-room flat price breakdown
sections.summary: A 4-room replacement flat is priced up to $563,000, and the Member asks for the price components.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: On pricing, the range of a 4-room flat in the replacement site is up to $563,000 and with BTO prices rising, I would be grateful if the Ministry could share what the breakdown of the components that make up this price?

sections.label: SERS residents' affordability concerns
sections.summary: Retired SERS residents worry about affording replacement homes, and welcome $30,000 subsidies and grants and a $10,000 removal allowance.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: For those who have retired like many Cheng San – Seletar residents who were selected to undergo SERS, they are worried that they cannot afford a replacement home.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Therefore, subsidies and grants of $30,000, and a $10,000 removal allowance for reasonable expenses are most welcome.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: (In English): Mr Deputy Speaker, Sir, I am committed to bringing my residents' appeal to Parliament.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: We are 606 affected households – hardworking Singaporeans who have worked for most of their lives to pay off their housing loans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: And many have been looking forward to living out their older years, debt free.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Each of these units tell different stories and many of them are close neighbours and even hope to ballot together to continue staying along the same corridors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Nadia Ahmad Samdin (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: I am grateful that we have written a successful housing story over the past few decades and while there are no easy answers in redevelopment, whether SERS or VERS, as our leases decay, we must write a new chapter, assure and bring along our people, so they know that they will always have a fair and concrete stake in our country.

sections.label: SERS grant and removal allowance
sections.summary: Eligible households receive a SERS grant of up to $30,000 and a $10,000 removal allowance on top of market compensation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: On top of the market compensation, eligible households will receive a SERS grant of up to $30,000 and a $10,000 removal allowance to cover the cost of moving.

sections.label: Replacement flat and LBS options
sections.summary: HDB offers a similar flat type at the replacement site on a 50-year term, and seniors may use the Lease Buyback Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: First, HDB will offer residents an option to purchase a similar flat type at the replacement site on a 50-year term.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Second, flat owners who are seniors will have an additional option of taking up the Lease Buyback Scheme, or LBS, on their existing flat and then buying a new replacement flat of the same flat type on a short lease.

sections.label: 50-year lease for seniors
sections.summary: About 540 residents aged 45 and above can consider the 50-year lease option, providing a home until age 95.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For the 540 or so residents aged 45 and above in this SERS exercise, they can consider this 50-year lease option which provides them with a home of life until the age of 95.

sections.label: Shorter-term ownership options for older owners
sections.summary: The government studied shorter-term ownership options for older home owners in SERS exercises and decided to offer this option from this SERS exercise onwards.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: In fact, we had been studying variations of shorter-term ownership options for older home owners involved in SERS exercises and have decided to offer this option now to better address the needs of older residents from this SERS exercise onwards.

sections.label: 50-year lease option case-by-case
sections.summary: Those not meeting the home-for-life criterion with extenuating circumstances may be considered for the 50-year lease option case-by-case, applying to Ang Mo Kio, Marsiling and future SERS exercises.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For those who do not meet the home-for-life criterion and face extenuating circumstances, we will consider availing them of the 50-year lease option on a case-by-case basis, if they are open to this option.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: These additional options will not be limited to the Ang Mo Kio exercise.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: They will also apply to the ongoing Marsiling acquisition exercise and to future SERS exercises too.
